_source: groundSpring Exp 022: FAO-56 ET₀ uncertainty propagation through Anderson localization
_references: Allen et al. (1998) FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56

_provenance.data_origin: FAO-56 Example 18 (Uccle, Belgium) + Anderson analytical model
_provenance.real_data_accession: N/A (analytical FAO-56 worked example + Anderson model)

fao56_inputs.description: FAO-56 Example 18 baseline with documented uncertainties

water_balance.description: Simple daily water balance: θ(t+1) = θ(t) + P/D - ET₀·Kc/D

expected.et0_mean_range_rationale: FAO-56 Example 18 (Uccle, 6 July) yields ET0 ≈ 3.88 mm/day; [3.5, 4.3] covers ±10% from MC perturbation of T, RH, wind, Rs inputs.
expected.et0_cv_range_rationale: Input uncertainties (T±0.5°C, RH±5%, wind±0.3, Rs±1.0) propagated through PM equation; CV ~ 0.04 analytically, [0.02, 0.10] covers nonlinear coupling.
expected.theta_final_range_rationale: 30-day water balance from theta_initial=0.35 with ET0~3.9 and P=2.0 mm/day; bounded by [theta_min=0.08, theta_max=0.45] with margin.
expected.theta_cv_range_rationale: Soil moisture CV depends on cumulative ET0 uncertainty over 30 days; range covers both low-variance (wet) and high-variance (dry) trajectories.
expected.xi_cv_range_rationale: Localization length xi ∝ 1/gamma depends nonlinearly on disorder W = slope*theta + intercept; CV amplification from theta to xi can be large near Anderson transition.
expected.xi_cv_to_et0_cv_ratio_min_rationale: Anderson localization amplifies input uncertainty: xi_cv / et0_cv > 0.5 means the localization channel preserves at least half the input noise.
